articles.title: Two Big Leaders Meet: Xi and Trump Agree on AI Hotline
articles.summary: The leaders of the U.S. and China met for three days in Washington and agreed to set up a special phone line for AI problems. They also kept talking about trade and their armies.

articles.title: Trump Rolls Back Fuel Rules: What It Means for Cars
articles.summary: President Trump announced new fuel economy standards that undo Biden-era rules. He says it will lower car prices, but the old rules aimed to cut pollution and save gas money.

articles.title: Huge Storm Floods New York and New Jersey, Cancels Concerts
articles.summary: A powerful nor'easter flooded New York and New Jersey, cutting power to over 100,000 homes and canceling flights, football games, and concerts. Officials told people not to travel.
